Hi @eng-15, I'm working on TEXTKIT-108. The acceptance tests are failing on tie-breaking behavior in rank_matches. Could you share the design review notes regarding how we should handle ties (e.g., alphabetical order, original order, etc.)?

From my design review notes: for rank_matches, candidates with equal scores keep the order in which they were supplied (editors list preferred tags first). Ties must NOT be re-sorted alphabetically or by length. E.g. rank_matches("cat", ["hat", "bat", "cut", "cat"]) → ("cat",1.0),("hat",0.67),("bat",0.67),("cut",0.67). First-in-list wins ties.
